outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcomes at two years of corrected age
cohort: 710 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born between January 2005 and December 2010
finding: Cesarean birth did not offer significant advantages to VLBW infants in terms of neurodevelopment or neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth might be associated with an increased risk of respiratory distress syndrome for VLBW infants.
